# an unlimited line size (-1) instead of a bigger number: also a valid setting
D=/var/lib/bench73415919/rancher/rke2/agent/etc/containerd
sudo sed -e '1{/^# File generated by rke2/d}' -e 's/^\( *max_container_log_line_size = \)16384$/\1-1/' $D/config.toml | sudo tee $D/config.toml.tmpl >/dev/null
bash /tmp/bench73415919/restart-rke2.sh

# the key put in the legacy CRI table (the one of containerd 1.x): containerd 2.x starts, warns, ignores it
D=/var/lib/bench73415919/rancher/rke2/agent/etc/containerd
sudo sed -e '1{/^# File generated by rke2/d}' -e "/^\[plugins\.'io\.containerd\.grpc\.v1\.cri'\]\$/a\  max_container_log_line_size = 131072" $D/config.toml | sudo tee $D/config.toml.tmpl >/dev/null
bash /tmp/bench73415919/restart-rke2.sh

# a template that extends the base and opens a table the base has already: not valid TOML
D=/var/lib/bench73415919/rancher/rke2/agent/etc/containerd
printf '{{ template "base" . }}\n\n[plugins.%s]\n  max_container_log_line_size = 131072\n' "'io.containerd.cri.v1.runtime'" | sudo tee $D/config.toml.tmpl >/dev/null
bash /tmp/bench73415919/restart-rke2.sh

# the generated file is edited and containerd is restarted by hand: it works, until RKE2 renders config.toml again
D=/var/lib/bench73415919/rancher/rke2/agent/etc/containerd
RUN=/run/bench73415919
sudo sed -i 's/^\( *max_container_log_line_size = \)16384$/\1131072/' $D/config.toml
P=$(sudo cat $RUN/containerd.pid)
sudo kill $P
while sudo kill -0 $P 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.5; done
sudo rm -f $RUN/containerd/containerd.sock
sudo setsid -f bash -c 'echo $$ > /run/bench73415919/containerd.pid; exec containerd --config '$D'/config.toml >/run/bench73415919/containerd.log 2>&1 </dev/null' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
for i in $(seq 1 60); do [ -S $RUN/containerd/containerd.sock ] && sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$RUN/containerd/containerd.sock version >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.5; done
